agent_response.response:
Install the dependency with:

Then save the following as `create_employee_handbook_workbook.py` and run it with Python:

    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

    embedded_pdf_text = """Employee Handbook
    Version 2.1
    Welcome to the company! This handbook outlines our policies, procedures, and expectations for all employees.
    Section 1: Introduction
    Our mission is to foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace.
    Section 2: Code of Conduct
    All employees are expected to adhere to the highest standards of professionalism.
    Section 3: Benefits
    We offer comprehensive health, dental, and retirement plans.
    Section 4: Leave Policies
    Employees are entitled to paid vacation, sick leave, and parental leave.
    Section 5: Safety
    Your safety is our priority. Please report any hazards immediately.
    Section 6: Acknowledgment
    Please sign and return the acknowledgment form at the end of this handbook.
    (End of Embedded PDF Text)"""

    first_page_image_ocr = """EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK
    Version 2.1
    Welcome to the company! This handbook outlines our policies, procedures, and expectations for all employees.
    Section 1: Introduction
    Our mission is to foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace.
    (End of First-Page Image OCR)"""

    workbook = Workbook()

    embedded_sheet = workbook.active
    embedded_sheet.title = "Embedded PDF Text"
    ocr_sheet = workbook.create_sheet("First-Page Image OCR")

    def populate_sheet(worksheet, content):
        for row_number, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
            cell = worksheet.cell(row=row_number, column=1, value=line)
            cell.alignment = Alignment(
                vertical="top",
                wrap_text=True,
            )

            if row_number == 1:
                cell.font = Font(bold=True, size=14)
            elif line.startswith("Section "):
                cell.font = Font(bold=True)

        worksheet.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(1)].width = 110
        worksheet.freeze_panes = "A1"

    populate_sheet(embedded_sheet, embedded_pdf_text)
    populate_sheet(ocr_sheet, first_page_image_ocr)

    output_path = "employee_handbook_extracted_content.xlsx"
    workbook.save(output_path)

    print(f"Created: {output_path}")

Run it with:

    python create_employee_handbook_workbook.py
